title: Pitch Ontology Work
description: One bibliographic record in sources/works.yaml. Fields beyond id and title are optional: a sparse but true record is preferred to a complete but guessed one. Declare what is missing in metadata_gaps.

handle.description: Repository identifier that is not a DOI: HAL id, Zenodo record, Internet Archive item.

mirror_url.description: A second freely readable copy: author PDF, repository deposit, archived copy.

domains.description: Analytical domains from ontology/domains.yaml, so the bibliography filters on the same categories as the graph.

metadata_gaps.description: Fields known to be missing or unconfirmed. Preferred over guessing.

verified.description: How this record's metadata was checked, and against what.
